import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem prime_order_unit_mod_pow_sub_one {a n p : ℕ}
    (ha : a > 1) (hn : n > 1) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n)
    (hφ : n ∣ (a ^ n - 1).totient) :
    ∃ u : (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ, orderOf u = p := by
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have h_gt : 1 < a ^ n := by
    calc 1 < a := ha
    _ ≤ a ^ n := Nat.le_self_pow (by omega) a
  have : NeZero (a ^ n - 1) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h_card : Fintype.card (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ = (a ^ n - 1).totient := ZMod.card_units_eq_totient (a ^ n - 1)
  have hdvd : p ∣ Fintype.card (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ := by
    rw [h_card]
    exact dvd_trans hpn hφ
  exact exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card p hdvd

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem prime_order_unit_mod_pow_sub_one {a n p : ℕ}
    (ha : a > 1) (hn : n > 1) (hp : p.Prime) (hpn : p ∣ n)
    (hφ : n ∣ (a ^ n - 1).totient) :
    ∃ u : (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ, orderOf u = p := by
  have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have han1 : 1 < a ^ n := Nat.one_lt_pow hn0 ha
  have hNpos : 0 < a ^ n - 1 := by omega
  have hNne : NeZero (a ^ n - 1) := ⟨by omega⟩
  have hp_dvd_tot : p ∣ (a ^ n - 1).totient := dvd_trans hpn hφ
  have hcard_eq : Fintype.card (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ = (a ^ n - 1).totient := by
    haveI : NeZero (a ^ n - 1) := hNne
    first
      | exact ZMod.card_units_eq_totient (a ^ n - 1)
      | exact (Nat.totient_eq_card_units (a ^ n - 1)).symm
      | simpa using ZMod.card_units_eq_totient (a ^ n - 1)
      | aesop
  have hcard_dvd : p ∣ Fintype.card (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ := by
    rw [hcard_eq]
    exact hp_dvd_tot
  first
    | obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card hp hcard_dvd
      exact ⟨u, hu⟩
    | obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Fintype.exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card hp hcard_dvd
      exact ⟨u, hu⟩
    | obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Monoid.exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card hp hcard_dvd
      exact ⟨u, hu⟩
    | haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card p hcard_dvd
      exact ⟨u, hu⟩
    | aesop
